trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

steps.purpose: User requests an appointment within 3 days.
steps.text: मुझे अगले 3 दिन में दिखाना है। क्या 3 दिन में slot है?

steps.purpose: Check for doctor availability in the next 3 days.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should call the availability tool for 3 days.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent checks the requested 3-day window for dermatology slots.

steps.purpose: Return availability for 3 days.
Agent informs the user that no slots are available in 3 days.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिये, अगले 3 दिन में dermatology department में कोई slot available नहीं है।

steps.purpose: User asks to check availability for 7 days.
steps.text: अच्छा, 3 दिन में कोई slot नहीं है? तो क्या 7 दिन में मिल जाएगा? आप 7 दिन का check कर लीजिये।

steps.purpose: Agent agrees to check 7 days and asks for registered name to verify identity.
steps.text: मैं 7 दिन का check करती हूँ। Security के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered name बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: User provides their registered name.
steps.text: हाँ, मेरा नाम सुरेश कुमार है।

steps.purpose: Verify the caller's identity using their registered name.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should reuse the patient ID established in the first turn without asking the user for it again.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent reuses the patient ID established earlier to verify identity, satisfying the slot value recall requirement.

steps.purpose: Return identity verification outcome.
Check for doctor availability in the next 7 days.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should call the availability tool for 7 days.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent expands the search to 7 days as requested by the user.

steps.purpose: Return availability for 7 days.
Agent informs the user that no slots are available in 7 days.
steps.text: सुरेश जी, मैंने check किया है, पर अगले 7 दिन में भी सारे slots full हैं।

steps.purpose: User asks to check availability for 14 days.
steps.text: 7 दिन में भी full है? ये तो problem है। एक काम कीजिये, 14 दिन का check कर लीजिये।

steps.purpose: Check for doctor availability in the next 14 days.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should call the availability tool for 14 days.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent expands the search to 14 days as requested by the user.

steps.purpose: Return availability for 14 days.
Agent informs the user that no slots are available and suggests using the app.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिये, 14 दिन तक भी कोई slot free नहीं है। आप चाहें तो हमारे hospital app पर daily check कर सकते हैं, वहाँ cancellation के slots दिख जाते हैं।

steps.purpose: User states they cannot use the app and requests a phone call alternative.
steps.text: नहीं, मुझे app चलाना नहीं आता। मैं app पर check नहीं कर पाऊँगा। क्या आप मुझे call करके बता सकती हैं जब slot आए?

steps.purpose: Agent offers an SMS alert alternative.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should adapt to the user's low digital literacy and offer a non-app alternative.
steps.text: मैं समझ सकती हूँ। मैं आपके record में note डाल देती हूँ। जब भी slot open होगा, आपको SMS आ जाएगा जिसमें एक number होगा, आप उस पर call करके book कर सकते हैं।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent provides a non-digital alternative since the user has low digital literacy and cannot use the app.

steps.purpose: User agrees to the SMS alert and confirms the note was added.
steps.text: ठीक है, SMS पढ़ लूँगा और call कर लूँगा। आपने note डाल दिया ना?

steps.purpose: Agent confirms the note and offers further assistance.
steps.text: जी बिल्कुल, मैंने note डाल दिया है। क्या मैं आपकी किसी और तरह से मदद कर सकती हूँ आज?

steps.purpose: User declines further assistance and ends the conversation.
steps.text: नहीं, बस यही पता करना था। धन्यवाद।

The agent first looks up the patient record, and after two conversational turns, reuses the timeframe to check availability in step s6. The target variant is moved from s12 to s6, as the patient ID was already used in s2, making it invalid for the delayed recall metric.
